purpose: Create one evidence-graded, criminal-led forensic and prosecutorial spine across the existing Concurso 36/2012 specialist pages without replacing their source corpora.
mandatory_boundaries: No criminal guilt or intent is presented as adjudicated fact.
No-response-located is not treated as proof that no response existed.
Adverse judicial acts and favourable/protective counterweights must both remain visible.
Downstream investors, advisers, regulators, authorities and operators are not attributed knowledge or complicity merely from exposure to the project.
The >600-row historical discovery inventory is not represented as the certified court docket.
RICPE 2020/2021 perimeter divergence is a reconciliation checkpoint, not a fraud finding.
The 15 October 2021 contradiction is a verified textual contradiction; its legal/criminal significance remains to be proved.
